subTitle: Have questions about going solar? We have answers.

faqs.question: How much can I save on my electricity bill with solar panels?
faqs.answer: Most homeowners see a 50–90% reduction in their monthly electricity bills after installing a SunSight solar system. The exact savings depend on your energy consumption, local utility rates, and system size. Our free energy assessment gives you a personalised projection.

faqs.question: How long does the installation process take?
faqs.answer: A typical residential installation is completed within 1–2 days once permits are approved. Our team handles all paperwork, council approvals, and grid connection applications, so the entire process from sign-off to switch-on usually takes 4–6 weeks.

faqs.question: What warranty do your solar panels and systems come with?
faqs.answer: Our solar panels carry a 25-year performance warranty guaranteeing at least 80% output, and a 12-year product warranty. Inverters come with a 10-year warranty. All installations are backed by our 5-year workmanship guarantee.

faqs.question: Do I need a battery storage system?
faqs.answer: A battery storage system lets you store excess solar energy to use at night or during grid outages, maximising your self-sufficiency. While not required, it dramatically increases your energy independence. We offer flexible packages with and without battery storage to suit your budget and goals.

faqs.question: Can my roof handle solar panels?
faqs.answer: Most roof types — including tile, metal, and flat roofs — are suitable for solar. During our free site assessment, our engineers will evaluate your roof's orientation, pitch, shading, and structural integrity to ensure a safe, optimised installation.

faqs.question: Do you offer commercial solar solutions?
faqs.answer: Absolutely. Our commercial division designs and installs large-scale solar systems for businesses, warehouses, farms, and industrial facilities. We provide detailed ROI analysis, bespoke system design, and ongoing monitoring through our smart dashboard.
